# ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/nex/img/title.jpg) ​ From November 6th (Fri) to November 8th (Sun), 2026, some Narita Express services will be suspended. Please check the following page for details. [https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/yokosuka-tunnel-koji/](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/yokosuka-tunnel-koji/) - [![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/nex/img/icon_train.png)About N'EX](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/nex/) - [![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/nex/img/icon_ticketing.png)Tickets](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/nex/tickets/) - [Ticket Guide (How to Buy)](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/nex/tickets/#nex_ticket) - [Using a Pass (How to Buy)](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/nex/tickets/#nex_pass) - [Reserving Seats](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/nex/tickets/#nex_reservation) You can board the N’EX in one of two ways: 1) with a ticket, or 2) with a pass. ## 1\. Ticket Guide (How to Buy) ### Reference image for ticket usage Paper Basic Fare Ticket + Super (Limited) Express Train ticket ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/nex/img/tickets/tickets_img01.png) or Suica (IC card) + Super (Limited) Express Train ticket ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/nex/img/tickets/tickets_img02.png) | Departure and arrival at Narita Airport Terminal 1 Station and Narita Airport Terminal 2・3 Station | Ordinary Car | Green Car (first class) | | --- | --- | --- | | Tōkyō | ¥3,140 | ¥3,910 | | Shinagawa
Shibuya
Shinjuku | ¥3,330 | ¥4,100 | | Yokohama | ¥4,480 | ¥6,750 | | Ōfuna | ¥4,810 | ¥7,080 | Fares and charges related to transport to Narita Airport Terminal 1 Station and Narita Airport Terminal 2・3 Station #### Notes - In addition to a regular Super (Limited) Express Train reserved seat ticket, Limited Express Unreserved Seat Tickets are available with pre-selected boarding dates and routes and unspecified carriages and seats. - Limited Express Unreserved Seat Tickets are equal in price to Limited Express Trains reserved seat tickets. - When using a Limited Express Unreserved Seat Ticket, please use the vacant seats found in the carriages. Customers can specify their carriages and seats at no extra charge once they have decided on a train to board. - Limited Express Unreserved Seat Ticket can be purchased even if a train does not have any vacant seats. Please use the deck areas in this case. You may also sit if you find a vacant seat. Refunds cannot be made if there are no vacant seats. - Same price throughout the year. - Super (Limited) Express Train reserved seat tickets and Basic Fare Tickets for a child (6 to 11 years old) are half the price of adult tickets. However, Green Tickets for a child share the price of those for adults. - A toddler (1 to 5 years old) and baby (11 months and under) may board free of charge, but a child ticket is required in the following cases. - When three or more toddlers accompany one adult or a child (tickets are required for the third and any additional toddlers). - When a toddler or baby occupies his or her own reserved seat or Green Car seat. - When a toddler travels alone.Conditions are subject to change. ### How to Purchase Tickets #### Purchasing a pass online Tickets can be reserved and purchased from overseas through JR-EAST Train Reservation. You can check the train times by searching via station of arrival/departure information. [Reserve seats online here \\ \\ JR-EAST Train ReservationOpens in a new window](https://www.eki-net.com/en/jreast-train-reservation/Top/Index) #### Purchasing at the station Super (Limited) Express Train reserved seat ticket for the N'EX can be purchased up to one month prior from the boarding date. Please make your purchases at JR EAST Travel Service Center, the JR Ticket Office (Midori-no-Madoguchi), or a Reserved Seat Ticket Vending Machine. ##### JR EAST Travel Service Center ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/nex/img/tickets/tickets_tsc.svg) We support our customers' journeys with JR EAST's vast railroad network of Shinkansen trains, limited express trains, and trains that run through the Eastern Japan area. Find out about how you can exchange passes for convenient railway transport, sightseeing information, and access various services including those for purchasing. [Click here for more information about the JR EAST Travel Service Center](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/e/customer_support/) ##### JR Ticket Office (Midori-no-Madoguchi) ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/nex/img/tickets/tickets_midori.svg) Basic Fare Tickets for limited express trains, all domestic Shinkansen including the Narita Express, and Green Car Super (Limited) Express Train reserved seat tickets can be purchased at the JR Ticket Office (Midori-no-Madoguchi). [Station Map for Major Stations](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/e/stations/) ##### Reserved Seat Ticket Vending Machine The Reserved Seat Ticket Vending Machine’s services are available in multiple languages allowing customers to purchase tickets and follow the on-screen instructions in their preferred language (English, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, and Korean). We accept banknotes of 1,000 yen, 2,000 yen, 5,000 yen, and 10,000 yen. Credit cards are also accepted. ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/renew/img/purchase_img_05.jpg) ## 2\. Using a Pass (How to Buy) ### Reference image for pass usage Pass + reserved seat ticket ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/nex/img/tickets/tickets_img03.png) ## Recommended pass for a great deal when using the Narita Express ### [N'EX TOKYO Round Trip Ticket](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/pass/nex.html) ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/nex/img/nex_pass_nex_map.png) Recommended for those traveling from Narita Airport to Shibuya, Shinjuku, Tōkyō, and other areas! Round-trip usage within the 14-day validity period **¥5,200** ​ [Purchase here Opens in a new window](https://www.eki-net.com/en/jreast-train-reservation/Top/Index) \\* From the linked reservation site, select "Purchase a pass" and select the appropriate pass. ### [JR EAST PASS](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/pass/eastpass.html) ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/nex/img/nex_pass_jep_map.png) Recommended for those who want to travel around all of Eastern Japan! Valid for 5 days / Unlimited rides **¥35,000** ​ Valid for 10 days / Unlimited rides **¥50,000** ​ [Purchase here Opens in a new window](https://www.eki-net.com/en/jreast-train-reservation/Top/Index) \\* From the linked reservation site, select "Purchase a pass" and select the appropriate pass. ### [JR TOKYO Wide Pass](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/pass/tokyowidepass.html) ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/nex/img/nex_pass_twp_map.png) Recommended for those traveling to areas near Tōkyō, such as Nikkō! Valid for 3 days / Unlimited rides **¥16,000** ​ [Purchase here Opens in a new window](https://www.eki-net.com/en/jreast-train-reservation/Top/Index) \\* From the linked reservation site, select "Purchase a pass" and select the appropriate pass. ## Reserving seats ### Riding in reserved seats (including Green Cars) You can reserve a seat using any of the options below. - Reserved seats (excluding Green Car seats) are available at no additional charge. - Same-day seat reservations are also available at JR Ticket Offices (Midori-no-Madoguchi) and reserved seat ticket vending machines equipped with passport readers at stations inside Narita Airport. - Make reservations up to one month in advance for a smoother trip! [![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/customer_support/img/train_reservation.png)Opens in a new window](https://www.eki-net.com/en/jreast-train-reservation/Top/Index) [Reserve seats onlineOpens in a new window](https://www.eki-net.com/en/jreast-train-reservation/Top/Index) - Reserve your seat without standing in line! ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/nex/img/tickets/tickets_machine.png) Reserve seats using a Reserved Seat Ticket Vending Machine Reserved seat ticket vending machines are installed at almost all stations in the Tōkyō metropolitan area. Click [here](https://www.jreast.co.jp/estation/facility_search.aspx?SearchCategoryCd=3) for locations (Japanese only) - A trusty concierge to support your journey! ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/nex/img/tickets/tickets_tsc_logo.png)![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/pass/img/img_seat-reservations01.png) [Reserve seats at a station](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/customer_support/) ### Riding without a seat reservation - Customers who have a Limited Express Unreserved Seat Ticket - Customers who wish to purchase a Super (Limited) Express Train ticket onboard - Customers without a designated seat who have purchased a discount ticket such as the JR EAST PASS **Please use the vacant seats of the Ordinary Cars.** - \\* The Green cars are unavailable. - \\* Tickets will be checked on-board, so please have your Limited Express Unreserved Seat Tickets and Discount tickets at hand. **If a passenger arrives with a reserved seat ticket, please offer your seat to them.** - \\* In such cases, please move to another available seat or the vestibule area. # Ticket Overview & Purchasing Guide

- [Tickets](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/ticket/guide.html#guide_about)
- [Purchasing tickets](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/ticket/guide.html#guide_purchase)

\\
and ticket refunds](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/ticket/changes.html)

## Tickets

The following types of tickets are available:

- ### Regular tickets



  - Basic Fare Tickets (Joshaken)





    ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_ticket.png)![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_fareticket.png)

  - \*Super (limited) express train tickets



    ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_ltdexp_reserved.png)

  - Basic fare + super (limited) express train tickets\*



    (A combined basic fare ticket + super (limited) express train ticket)



    ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_ticket_ltdexp.png)


There are reserved seat tickets with specifically assigned seats and non-reserved seat tickets available.

- ### Pass

![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_pass.png)
- [**Shinkansen e-ticket/  Express Train e-ticket (basic fare required)**![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/eticket/eticket_flow_img_reserve.png)](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/ticket/eticket.html)
- [**Green Car on local trains   (non-reserved seat)**![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/eticket/eticket_flow_img_greencar.png)](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/green/)

- Basic fare tickets











Basic fare tickets cover the basic fare for riding a train.

The price depends on the area you want to go to.

This basic ticket is always required to board a train.



There are three main types of basic fare tickets.





  - Paper basic fare tickets

    (for long distances)
    ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_fareticket.png)
  - Paper basic fare tickets

    (for short distances)
    ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_ticket.png)
  - Suica

    (IC card)


    ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_welcomesuica.png)![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_suica.png)


[How to read tickets](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/ticket/examining.html)

- Suica (IC card)













![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_welcomesuica.png)![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_suica.png)





This is a basic fare ticket in the form of an IC card.

You can top up the card beforehand, so you don’t need to buy a ticket every time you ride.

A convenient option, as you just tap the card on the ticket gate.



[About Welcome Suica](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/welcomesuica/welcomesuica.html) [About Suica](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/pass/suica.html)

- Super (limited) express train tickets













![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_ltdexp_reserved.png)



When riding a shinkansen or limited express train, this ticket needs to be purchased in addition to the basic fare ticket.

The main types of super (limited) express train tickets are reserved seat tickets with specifically assigned seats and non-reserved seat tickets for non-reserved seat cars.



With a non-reserved seat ticket, you can only sit in non-reserved seat cars.

Note that the Narita Express and shinkasen including the Hayabusa and Kagayaki only have reserved-seat cars.

- Passes













![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_pass.png)



We offer regular tickets as well as rail passes to those who are visiting Japan.

Most passes include the basic ticket + super (limited) express ticket fare, for cheaper travel compared to using regular tickets depending on the area.



This option is super convenient, as you don’t need to buy new basic fare and super (limited) express tickets for each city you go to.

We hope this option comes in handy during your travels.









![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/img_pass_eastpass.png)![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/img_pass_tokyowidepass.png)



[Types of passes](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/pass/) [Picking up your pass](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/pass/purchase.html)


## Types of trains and the required tickets

JR East has three main types of trains.

- [**Shinkansen**\\
![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_navi_shinkansen.png)](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/ticket/guide.html#guide_ticketType_shinkansen)
- [**Limited express trains**\\
![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_navi_express.png)](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/ticket/guide.html#guide_ticketType_express)
- [**Local trains (rapid & conventional lines)**\\
![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_navi_local.png)](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/ticket/guide.html#guide_ticketType_local)

- ### Tickets needed to ride the shinkansen


![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_shinkansen.png)





  - For reserved seats (including Green Cars)

    - Basic fare ticket + super (limited) express train reserved seat ticket
      ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_fareticket.png)![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_ltdexp_reserved.png)
    - Pass + reserved seat ticket
      ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_pass.png)![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_reserved_seat_ticket.png)

  - To sit in a non-reserved seat\*​

    - Basic fare ticket + super (limited) express train non-reserved seat ticket
      ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_fareticket.png)![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_ltdexp.png)
    - Just a pass
      ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_pass.png)

You can only sit in the non-reserved seat cars.

- ### Tickets needed to ride the limited express trains


![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_express.png)





  - For reserved seats (including Green Cars)

    - Basic fare ticket or Suica + super (limited) express train reserved seat ticket


      ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_fareticket.png)

      OR



      ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_welcomesuica.png)![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_suica.png)



      Suica & Welcome Suica cannot be used in some areas.



      ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_ltdexp_reserved.png)
    - Pass + reserved seat ticket
      ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_pass.png)![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_reserved_seat_ticket.png)

  - To sit in a non-reserved seat\*​

    - Basic fare ticket or Suica + super (limited) express train non-reserved seat ticket


      ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_fareticket.png)

      OR



      ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_welcomesuica.png)![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_suica.png)



      Suica & Welcome Suica cannot be used in some areas.



      ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_ltdexp.png)
    - Just a pass
      ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_pass.png)

You can only sit in the non-reserved seat cars.

[Trains & routes](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/traininformation/)

- ### Tickets needed to ride local trains (rapid & conventional lines)


![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_local.png)







Pass or basic fare ticket or Suica



  - ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_pass.png)
  - ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_ticket.png)![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_fareticket.png)

  - ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_welcomesuica.png)![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/illust_suica.png)


[Enjoy a more comfortable journey on the Green Car.\\
\\
**Green Cars on Local Trains (Non-reserved seat)** \\
\\
A surcharge is required to use this service.\\
\\
![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/eticket/eticket_illust_greencar.png)](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/green/)

## Purchasing tickets

You can purchase tickets online (via JR-EAST Train Reservation) from Japan and abroad,

or at train stations after arriving in Japan. (\*Passes are sold at select stations.)

- [Buy yours before coming to Japan!\\
![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/customer_support/img/train_reservation.png)\\

## Picking up tickets

Reserved tickets purchased via JR-EAST Train Reservation can be picked up as shown below.

- [![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/img_passport-reader.png)\\

## Narita Express is the best way to get to Tokyo from Narita Airport

- The fastest train from Narita Airport Station to Tōkyō Station takes just 53 minutes! No transfers needed to reach major stations.
- Equipped with luggage space and power outlets for a comfortable journey.
- Discount passes can be used

The Narita Express "N'EX" is a fast, convenient, and comfortable limited express train that directly connects Narita International Airport with major cities and districts including Tokyo, Shinagawa, Shibuya, Shinjuku and Yokohama. Changing trains along the way is stress-free!

The Narita Express (N'EX) is the best choice when traveling to Tokyo.

Equipped with a full range of in-car facilities, N'EX promises comfortable transportation.

## Narita Express Information

We have adopted universal design principles in line with the brand image of N'EX (airport limited express) to create comfort and security.

### Facilities

Features and a design suited for limited express access to airports. In-car facilities have been further enhanced, making transportation from Narita Airport even more comfortable.

#### Luggage storage area \*No reservation required

![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/nex/img/facilities_img07.jpg)

![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/nex/img/facilities_img08.jpg)

Security cameras are installed near the doorways and in the luggage compartment areas. The luggage compartment areas of each train is fitted with a dial-type lock. Additionally, we are installing emergency alert devices in the trains that allow for communication with crew members to improve security.

#### Multilingual support available

![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/nex/img/facilities_img01.jpg)

![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/nex/img/facilities_img02.jpg)

Installed onboard are large LCD guidance devices that provide information including information about destinations, service statuses, news, weather reports, and flight information (inbound trains) in four languages (English, Chinese, Korean, and Japanese).

\\* Some content is only available in two languages (English and Japanese).

#### Safe for wheelchair users and those with children

![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/nex/img/facilities_img03.jpg)Multipurpose room

![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/nex/img/facilities_img04.jpg)Large Western-style toilet

![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/nex/img/facilities_img05.jpg)The Western-style toilets are equipped with baby beds and baby chairs.

![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/nex/img/facilities_img06.jpg)Braille signage (doorways and toilets)

Many accessibility-related measures have been implemented including a large Western-style toilet for users of electric wheelchairs, low-hanging luggage racks, and minimized gaps between platforms and trains.

### Seat

The N'EX is made up of Green Cars (first class) and Ordinary Cars. Please relax in the comfortable interior and as appropriate to what you require.

#### Green Car (first class)

![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/nex/img/seating_img01.jpg)

Ordinary seat features

- Seat pitch: 1,020 mm

## FAQ

Q.

Where should I store my luggage on the Narita Express? Is a reservation required?

A.

The Narita Express has overhead luggage racks and storage areas for large luggage.

The large luggage area does not require a reservation.

However, space is limited, so it is available on a first-come, first-served basis.

Depending on the size and shape of your luggage, it may not fit.

If the large luggage area is full, please place your luggage at your feet.

If you are bringing large luggage on board, please also check the [Oversized Luggage Guide.](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/luggage-area/) ​

For more information, please call the number below.

JR East Infoline (available in Japanese, English, Chinese, and Korean)050-2016-1603（JST 10:00 -18:00）International calls from overseas: +81-50-2016-1603

Q.

Which stations does the Narita Express stop at?

A.

For details about Narita Express stops, please go [here](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/nex/#nex_routemap).

Q.

Where can the N'EX TOKYO Round Trip Ticket be picked up?

A.

This ticket can only be picked up at

Narita Airport Terminal 1 Station or

Narita Airport Terminal 2・3 Station.

You can pick up your ticket at the following locations:

- • JR EAST Travel Service Center and JR Ticket Office (Midori-no-Madoguchi) counters
- • Ticket vending machines with passport readers (reserved seat ticket vending machines equipped with passport readers)

You can also make same-day seat reservations at JR EAST Travel Service Center and JR Ticket Office (Midori-no-Madoguchi) counters and ticket vending machines equipped with passport readers at stations inside Narita Airport.

Narita Airport Terminal 1 Station

- • JR EAST Travel Service Center (8:30–19:00)
- • Ticket vending machines with passport readers (reserved seat ticket vending machines equipped with passport readers) (6:30–21:45)
- • JR Ticket Offices (Midori-no-Madoguchi) (6:30–21:45)
[Station MapOpens in a new window](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/e/stations/e1130.html)


Narita Airport Terminal 2・3 Station

- • JR EAST Travel Service Centers (8:30–20:00)
- • Ticket vending machines with passport readers (reserved seat ticket vending machines equipped with passport readers) (6:30–21:45)
- • JR Ticket Offices (Midori-no-Madoguchi) (6:30–21:45)
[Station MapOpens in a new window](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/e/stations/e611.html)


For more information, see the [N'EX TOKYO Round Trip Ticket](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/pass/nex.html) page.

Q.

Do the outbound and return rides on the N'EX TOKYO Round Trip Ticket have to be between the same stations?

For example:

- • Outbound: Narita Airport Terminal 1 Station → Shinjuku Station
- • Return: Tōkyō Station → Narita Airport Terminal 1 Station

A.

No, they do not have to be between the same stations.

For example:

- • Outbound: Narita Airport Terminal 1 Station → Shinjuku Station
- • Return: Tōkyō Station → Narita Airport Terminal 1 Station

As shown above, you can use the ticket for different stations.

However, there are rules for how the ticket can be used.

- • For the outbound trip, use the ticket from Narita Airport → Tokyo (Central Tokyo: Tokyo and the surrounding area, including Yokohama and Ōfuna)
- • For the return trip, use the ticket from Tokyo (Central Tokyo: Tokyo and the surrounding area, including Yokohama and Ōfuna) → Narita Airport

.

The reverse is not permitted (Tokyo → Narita Airport for the outbound trip and Narita Airport → Tokyo for the return trip).

For more information, see the [N'EX TOKYO Round Trip Ticket](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/pass/nex.html#pass_availableArea) page.

Q.

Can I use the N'EX TOKYO Round Trip Ticket to ride other trains on the same day I ride the Narita Express?

A.

The N'EX TOKYO Round Trip Ticket is not an unlimited pass.

You can only use it twice.

(Example)

- • First trip: Narita Airport → JR stations in Tokyo and the surrounding area
- • Second trip: JR stations in Tokyo and the surrounding area → Narita Airport

After riding the Narita Express, you can transfer to other JR trains and travel to any station covered by the ticket at no extra cost as long as you do not exit the ticket gates.

The same applies to the return trip. As long as you do not exit the ticket gates, you can transfer from another JR train to the Narita Express.

\*Note

Once you exit the ticket gates, the ticket can no longer be used.

For details on the area covered by the ticket, please see the [N'EX TOKYO Round Trip Ticket](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/pass/nex.html) page.

Q.

I reserved a Narita Express ticket through JR-EAST Train Reservation. What should I do if my flight is delayed and I miss my reserved train?

A.

If you think you may miss your train or expect to arrive early, please visit the JR East [website(Opens in a new window)](https://www.eki-net.com/en/jreast-train-reservation/Top/Index) to cancel your current reservation and reserve a different train. For details on cancellation deadlines and refund fees (fees charged when you receive a ticket refund), please see the [Refund Fees (for ticket refunds) page (Opens in a new window)](https://www.eki-net.com/top/tr/guide/change/#c-headerAcc_02_01).

If you miss your reserved train, you can take a later train on the same day without changing your ticket.

However, you will not have an assigned seat. Please take any available seat.

If a passenger with a reservation for that seat arrives, you must give up the seat.

# How to Buy a Pass

- 1





Purchase a pass

![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/pass/img/purchase/purchase_howto01.svg)

Purchases can be made online via JR-EAST Train Reservation, at ticket offices in Japan, or at travel agencies outside of Japan.

- 2





Pick up your pass

![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/pass/img/purchase/purchase_howto02.svg)

You can pick up or purchase a pass at major train stations.

- 3





Use your pass

![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/pass/img/purchase/purchase_howto03.svg)

Please use the automatic ticket gate machines.


## Three Ways to Purchase

- ![Quick & Easy!](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/pass/img/purchase/purchase_quick_easy.svg)Purchasing a pass online on the JR-EAST Train Reservation website











1. 1





     Purchase



     Purchase your pass on the JR-EAST Train Reservation website.

     [![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/common/img/logo_tr02.svg)\\
     \\
     Reserve Today!\\
     \\
     JR-East Train Reservation\\
     \\
     Opens in a new window](https://www.eki-net.com/en/jreast-train-reservation/Top/Index)

2. 2





     Pick up



     You need to pick up your pass once you have arrived in Japan.

     You’ll need your passport to receive your pass. You cannot receive a pass if you only have a copy of your passport.

     There are two ways to pick up your pass.
     1. 1.Pick up your pass from a Reserved Seat Ticket Vending Machine with a passport reader





        You can pick up your pass from Reserved Seat Ticket Vending Machines with passport readers available at designated stations. Please have your passport with an IC chip ready (not a copy).



        ![Reserved Seat Ticket Vending Machine with passport reader: Black symbol](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/pass/img/purchase/purchase_logo_railpass_blk.png)![Reserved Seat Ticket Vending Machine with passport reader: Red symbol](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/pass/img/purchase/purchase_logo_railpass_red.png)

        Reserved Seat Ticket Vending Machines with passport readers are marked with these symbols







        Some Reserved Seat Ticket Vending Machines with passport readers have longer sales hours than Travel Service Centers and other similar purchase locations. You’ll find them very convenient. For inquiries regarding purchases or refunds, please contact the point of purchase during business hours.

        [Click here to see where you can find Reserved Seat Ticket Vending Machines with passport readersOpens in a new window](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/ticketwindow/)



        ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/pass/img/purchase/purchase_passport-reader.png)

        [![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/img_bnr_service_centers_02.jpg)\\
        \\
        Stations where passes can be picked up](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/ticketwindow/)

     2. 2.Pick up your pass from a Travel Service Center





        Please have your passport ready (not a copy). After confirming your eligibility, your pass will be issued.

        You can pick up your pass from Travel Service Centers that offer this service.





        [![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/img_bnr_service_centers.jpg)\\
        \\
        Find a Travel Service Center where you can pick up your pass](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/ticketwindow/)



        For details on picking up your pass, please see the [JR-EAST Train Reservation User GuideOpens in a new window](https://www.eki-net.com/top/tr/guide/receive_geton/).
3. 3





     Use



     Passes can be used within the period of validity from their specified start date. Please use the automatic ticket gate machines at stations.


- Purchasing a pass from a travel agency in another country











1. 1





     Purchase



     Before your arrival in Japan, purchase a voucher (e-ticket) from a travel agency or other such vendor.

     Tokyo 1-Day Ticket, Tokyo Metropolitan District Pass, NONBIRI Holiday Suica Pass, and SENDAI AREA PASS are not sold by overseas travel agencies.

2. 2





     Collect your pass



     Please present the voucher (e-ticket) issued by your travel agency and your passport at a pickup location once you’ve arrived in Japan.

     We cannot issue you a pass if you only have a copy of your passport. We will confirm your eligibility and then issue you a pass.

     [![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/img_bnr_service_centers.jpg)\\
     \\
     Find a Travel Service Center where you can pick up your pass](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/ticketwindow/)



     For details on picking up your pass, please see the [JR-EAST Train Reservation User GuideOpens in a new window](https://www.eki-net.com/top/tr/guide/receive_geton/).

3. 3





     Use



     Passes can be used within the period of validity from their specified start date. Please use the automatic ticket gate machines at stations.


- Purchasing at a ticket office in Japan











1. 1





     Purchase



     A passport is required for purchases. You cannot receive a pass if you only have a copy of your passport.

     There are two ways to purchase passes.

     The Hokuriku Arch Pass cannot be purchased in Japan.
     1. 1.Purchase a pass from a Reserved Seat Ticket Vending Machine with a passport reader





        You can purchase a pass from Reserved Seat Ticket Vending Machines with passport readers available at designated stations. Please have your passport with an IC chip ready (not a copy).



        ![Reserved Seat Ticket Vending Machine with passport reader: Black symbol](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/pass/img/purchase/purchase_logo_railpass_blk.png)![Reserved Seat Ticket Vending Machine with passport reader: Red symbol](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/pass/img/purchase/purchase_logo_railpass_red.png)

        Reserved Seat Ticket Vending Machines with passport readers are marked with these symbols







        Some Reserved Seat Ticket Vending Machines with passport readers have longer sales hours than Travel Service Centers and other similar purchase locations. You’ll find them very convenient. For inquiries regarding purchases or refunds, please contact the point of purchase during business hours.

        [Click here to see where you can find Reserved Seat Ticket Vending Machines with passport readersOpens in a new window](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/ticketwindow/)



        ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/pass/img/purchase/purchase_passport-reader.png)

     2. 2.Purchase a pass at a Travel Service Center





        Please have your passport ready (not a copy). You can purchase a pass at a Travel Service Center.





        [![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/img_bnr_service_centers.jpg)\\
        \\
        Find a Travel Service Center where you can purchase a pass](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/ticketwindow/)



        For details on purchasing a pass, please see the [JR-EAST Train Reservation User GuideOpens in a new window](https://www.eki-net.com/top/tr/guide/).
2. 2





     Use



     Passes can be used within the period of validity from their specified start date. Please use the automatic ticket gate machines at stations.


Eligibility

Customers who fulfill the conditions below can purchase and use this pass.

- You must be a foreign national with a passport issued by a country other than Japan (Japanese nationals cannot use this pass.)​
- Customers visiting Japan from overseas on a Temporary Visitor visa\*  - The following passes do not have this requirement.    - JR EAST PASS
    - JR EAST PASS (Tohoku area)
    - JR EAST PASS (Nagano, Niigata area)
    - JR TOKYO Wide Pass
    - N'EX TOKYO Round Trip Ticket
    - Tokyo 1-Day Ticket
    - Tokyo Metropolitan District Pass
    - NONBIRI Holiday Suica Pass
    - SENDAI AREA PASS
- Please have the pass user present a valid passport (original) when making a purchase. (Passes cannot be purchased by anyone else, including family members.)

## Reserving Seats

- [Make reservations up to one month \\
\\
in advance for a smoother trip!\\
![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/customer_support/img/train_reservation.png)\\
Reserve tickets online\\
Opens in a new window](https://www.eki-net.com/en/jreast-train-reservation/Top/Index)
- [Reserve your seat without \\
\\
standing in line!\\
![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/pass/img/img_seat-reservations04.jpg)\\
Reserve seats using a \\
\\
Reserved Seat Ticket Vending Machine](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/ticketwindow/)
- [A trusty concierge to \\
\\
support your journey!\\
![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/guide/img_bnr_service_centers.jpg)![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/pass/img/img_seat-reservations01.png)\\
Reserve seats at a station](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/customer_support/)

## Changes/Refunds

### Changes

You cannot change the period of validity after collecting or purchasing a pass, except in certain cases.

To make changes to a pass purchased on the JR-EAST Train Reservation website before you have collected it, please see the [User GuideOpens in a new window](https://www.eki-net.com/top/tr/guide/change/).

### Refunds

Refunds vary depending on where you purchased your pass.

- If you purchased a pass from JR-EAST Train Reservation  1. 1.Before picking up your pass



       Please complete the necessary procedures on the JR-EAST Train Reservation website by 11:50 p.m. (JST) on the day before the start date of the period of use. There are no fees. Refunds can also be processed online from 11:50 p.m. (JST) on the day before the start date of the period of use until 11:50 p.m. (JST) on the last day of the period of validity. However, in this case, a fee will be charged. (Refunds cannot be made at train stations)





       2.After picking up your actual pass



       If your pass is unused and you request a refund at the point of purchase within the period of validity, you can receive a refund for a set fee.
- If you purchased a pass in Japan  1. If your pass is unused and you request a refund at the point of purchase within the period of validity, you can receive a refund for a set fee.
- If you purchased a pass at a travel agency  1. 1.Before collecting your pass



       Please contact the travel agency that you purchased your pass from. In such cases, we cannot provide refunds.





       2.Once the pass is issued



       If your pass is unused and you request a refund at the point of purchase within the period of validity, you can receive a refund for a set fee.

Please note

- In either case, if you have reserved a seat, no refunds can be made after the reserved train’s departure time. If you are not going to take the train your reservation is for, please be sure to cancel your reserved seat.

# FAQ

Here are answers to common questions we receive from customers.

- [![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/faq/img/icon_ticket.png)\\

![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/faq/img/icon_ticket.png)

## Tickets

- Q. Where can I buy tickets?











A.(From your country of residence)

Tickets can be purchased from JR EAST’s official site below from 10:00 (JST) one month before the boarding date.





(From your country of residence)

Passes can be purchased from JR EAST’s official site below from 10:00 (JST) one month before the boarding date.

URL: [https://www.eki-net.com/jreast-train-reservation/Top/Index?Opens in a new window.](https://www.eki-net.com/en/jreast-train-reservation/Top/Index)Go [here](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/ticket/) to learn more about picking up your tickets after purchasing them. \\* Available tickets are limited to JR EAST, JR Hokkaido, and the Hokuriku Shinkansen. For other lines, such as the Tokaido Shinkansen, please visit the respective JR company’s website.



(After arriving in Japan)

You can purchase tickets from JR-EAST Train Reservation, at ticket counters of major stations, Reserved Seat Ticket Vending Machines, and JR EAST Travel Service Center starting from 10:00 (JST) one month before the boarding date.

For JR-EAST Train Reservation, click [here. Opens in a new window.](https://www.eki-net.com/en/jreast-train-reservation/Top/Index)For information on JR EAST Travel Service Center, click [here.](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/customer_support/)For information on the Reserved Seat Ticket Vending Machines, click [here.](https://www.jreast.co.jp/estation/facility_search.aspx?SearchCategoryCd=3) ​ ​

- Q.How can I change or get a refund for my ticket?











A. Ticket changes and refunds are handled differently depending on the circumstances.





Ticket changes and refunds are handled differently depending on the circumstances.



■ Ticket changes



  - Exchanging unused tickets

     Unused tickets that are still within their validity period (some ticket types excluded) can be exchanged once for the same type free of charge. Any difference in fare must be paid, and any excess will be refunded.
  - Changes after the start of your trip

    If you wish to change your ticket after starting your journey, you will be required to pay any additional fares or charges. However, no refund will be made even if the total paid exceeds the revised fare. For basic fare tickets, a refund may be available if there is an unused portion of at least 101 km.

■ Ticket refunds

  - Refunds for unused tickets

    An unused ticket that is still within its validity period may be refunded, subject to a prescribed cancellation charge.

\\* Except where special conditions apply, passes may be refunded only if they are unused and within their validity period. Refunds must be made at the place of purchase and are subject to a handling fee. If you have a reserved seat (to be used with a pass), refunds cannot be made after the scheduled departure time of the train.

​ [Go here](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/ticket/changes.html) for more information.

To cancel tickets reserved through JR-EAST Train Reservation, please refer [hereOpens in a new window](https://www.eki-net.com/top/tr/guide/change/).

- Q. What is JR-EAST Train Reservation?

What are the perks of using it?











A.On JR EAST’s official ticket reservation site, you can purchase rail passes and individual tickets.





On JR EAST’s official ticket reservation site, you can purchase rail passes and individual tickets.

The service is free to join and use, and there are no ticketing fees.

Refunds can be handled free of charge for individual tickets until 21:00 (JST) on the day before the date of usage and for rail passes until 23:50 (JST) on the day before the usage start date.

This convenient option lets you pick up your ticket or pass at the station without having to wait in the ticket office line.

For more information, go [hereopens in a new window](https://www.eki-net.com/top/tr/guide/about/).

- Q. From what age do children need a ticket?

From when do I need to purchase an adult fare ticket?











A.​ ​Tickets are required for children aged 6 and over. Children aged 11 and under are eligible for child fares, while those aged 12 and over must pay the adult fare.





A ticket is required for children aged 6 and over. Children aged 11 and under are eligible for child fares, while those aged 12 and over must pay the adult fare.

Children under 6 years old will need a ticket or pass to secure a reserved seat.

- Q.I lost my ticket.

Can it be reissued?











A.If you lose your ticket before or after the start of your trip, you will have to purchase a new ticket at full price.





If you lose your ticket before or after the start of your trip, you will have to purchase a new ticket at full price.

In this case, the ticket will be marked Funshitsusai (紛失再). If you purchase a ticket again, you will receive a Saishujushoumei (再収受証明) at the manned gate of your destination station, so please keep it with you.

Refunds for tickets will incur a handling fee.


![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/material/img/icon_pass.svg)

## Passes

- Q.How do rail passes work?











A.This type of ticket gives you unlimited rides on select trains in a designated area for a set period of time.





This type of ticket gives you unlimited rides on select trains in a designated area for a set period of time.

JR EAST sells passes for areas in eastern Japan, including the Tokyo area, as well as Tohoku (Sendai, Aomori, and Yamagata) with its beautiful four seasons, and Nagano and Niigata, which are famous for their snow leisure activities and hot springs.

Please [go here](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/pass/) for more information.

- Q. Where can I buy a rail pass?











A.(From your country of residence)

Tickets can be purchased from JR EAST’s official site below from 10:00 (JST) one month before the boarding date.





(From your country of residence)

Passes can be purchased from JR EAST’s official site below from 10:00 (JST) one month before the boarding date.

URL: [https://www.eki-net.com/jreast-train-reservation/Top/Index?Opens in a new window.](https://www.eki-net.com/en/jreast-train-reservation/Top/Index)Go [here](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/ticketwindow/) to learn more about picking up your passes after purchasing them.



(After arriving in Japan)

You can purchase tickets from JR-EAST Train Reservation, at ticket counters of major stations, Reserved Seat Ticket Vending Machines, and JR EAST Travel Service Center starting from 10:00 (JST) one month before the boarding date. (Some tickets are not available)

Opens in a new window](https://www.jreast.co.jp/e/downloads/pdf/passport_operation_e.pdf)

- Q.​ ​I want to use my JR TOKYO Wide Pass to go to Nagano. The area up to Sakudaira is covered, but do I need to get off the train once?











A.If you purchase a ticket for the area not covered by your pass beforehand at a ticket office, you can continue riding without needing to get off the train.





If you purchase a ticket for an area not covered by your pass beforehand at a ticket office, you can continue riding without needing to get off the train.

In this particular case, you can keep riding if you buy a separate ticket for the portion from Sakudaira to Nagano.

Reservations cannot be made through JR-EAST Train Reservation, so please inquire at the station.

A:Please see [here](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/ticketwindow/) for information on pick-up locations.





Please see [here](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/ticketwindow/) for information on pick-up locations.

Can I get a receipt?

Yes, it can be issued.

A valid passport is required to purchase, exchange, and use a rail pass.

Rail pass holders can make up to 15 online reservations, including the pass itself.

# ![From Hakodate to Aomori and Akita](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/akita/meettheheart/topics/img/sub-main.jpg)![From Hakodate to Aomori and Akita](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/akita/meettheheart/topics/img/sp-sub.jpg)

Recommended for those traveling to the Tohoku region, including Akita and Aomori!

[JR-EAST Train Reservation Opens in a new window](https://www.eki-net.com/en/jreast-train-reservation/Top/Index)

#001

### A fun day at Resort Shirakami

![Resort Shirakami Shirakami](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/akita/meettheheart/topics/column/img/g001/main.jpg)

#### My first impression of the Gono Line is that it is a railway running along the coast of the Sea of Japan.  It connects cities and towns across the two prefectures of Akita and Aomori, and was previously known as a "local line" used as a daily commuter for the people living there, but it is also known as the only railway connecting the entrance stations to the Shirakami-Sanchi, a UNESCO World Heritage Site registered in 1993, and has many charms.  Among the trains that run on the Gono Line, there are three unique trains called "Resort Shirakami." "Aoike" is based on white and blue, representing the Sea of Japan, the horizon, and the Twelve Lakes; "Buna" has an ink green and woody interior, representing the virgin forests of the Shirakami Mountains; and "Kumagera" has a yellow-orange exterior, representing the sunset on the Gono Line and the black woodpeckers that live in this area. Why not try riding the "Buna" that travels between Akita Station and Aomori Station and be amazed?  Also, when boarding Resort Shirakami, please be careful about ticket issuing. All reserved seat on Resort Shirakami are reserved, so you must purchase both the boarding ticket and seat ticket in advance. Even if you have JR EAST PASS (Tohoku area) or a rail pass valid in the Tohoku area, you must purchase seat ticket in advance.

POINT1

##### The Charm of Resort Shirakami

Resort Shirakami 1 leaves Akita Station in the morning and travels along the Gono Line to Aomori Station in 5 hours and 10 minutes, during which passengers can enjoy scenic views and fun activities.

"Buna" is inspired by the virgin forests of Shirakami-Sanchi and has extra-large windows so passengers can enjoy the scenery. The extra-wide seats, with a seat pitch and width based on the warm colors of red and orange, provide excellent comfort. You can enjoy the fusion of the interior, which is inspired by the summer festivals of Tohoku, and the woody interior that expresses the charm of Shirakami-Sanchi.

The three trains of Resort Shirakami are equipped with box seats, which are unique among trains that run on the Gono Line. Car No. 2 is partitioned into a compartment facing the sea, and is a semi-private compartment with an extra-large window and a multi-purpose table, where you can eat your favorite bento together while looking out at the majestic sea along the coast of the Sea of Japan.

![Resort Shirakami Shirakami box seats](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/akita/meettheheart/topics/column/img/g001/image01.jpg)Box seats on Resort Shirakami Buna train.![Resort Shirakami Shirakami, Ordinary Car](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/akita/meettheheart/topics/column/img/g001/image02.jpg)Ordinary Car from Resort Shirakami Kureha train.

There are panoramic observation rooms at both ends of the train, where passengers can enjoy the feeling of being surrounded by nature through the driver's cabin at the front. Just like regular seats, there are large windows and seats on both sides of the observation rooms, which passengers can use freely at any time while the train is moving. Stamps and postcards with a design exclusive to Resort Shirakami are also on sale. Make sure to take them with you on your commemorative trip!

![Car No. 4 observation deck](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/akita/meettheheart/topics/column/img/g001/image03.jpg)The observation deck of car number 4 can be seen in the background.![Commemorative stamp with illustration of the No. 4 car, the "Kureha" train](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/akita/meettheheart/topics/column/img/g001/image04.jpg)A commemorative stamp with an illustration of the No. 4 car, the Kurogane formation.

Car 2 has a convenience store with an automatic fare machine that sells snacks and drinks. Payment can be made with IC cards such as Suica or credit cards, but cash is not accepted. The default language is Japanese, but English can also be displayed.

![Self-service shop](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/akita/meettheheart/topics/column/img/g001/image05.jpg)A self-service shop selling Resort Shirakami railway merchandise.

POINT 2

##### From Akita to Tsugaru: From Morning to Noon

Shortly after departing from Akita Station, the train arrives at Higashi-Noshiro Station, the starting point of the Gono Line. The train stops for seven minutes, allowing passengers to take photos on the platform.

After a short break in Higashi-Noshiro, the train heads to Noshiro Station. Noshiro City is nicknamed "Town of Trees" and is a thriving producer of Akita cedar.

There is a beautiful model of the Beech train on the platform.

Noshiro City is also known as a "basketball town" and is the setting for a famous basketball anime. The train stops at Noshiro Station for about 10 minutes, where passengers will notice a basketball court on the platform. As a special privilege for those who ride Resort Shirakami, you can also try out a full-scale shot. Let's give it a try!

We arrived at Akita Shirakami Station, the main entrance station to the UNESCO World Heritage Site "Shirakami-Sanchi." The tourist stationmaster, dressed in a pure white uniform, was already standing on the platform, welcoming passengers aboard Resort Shirakami and Kurogi trains.

![Resort Shirakami waiting at Akita Station](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/akita/meettheheart/topics/column/img/g001/image06.jpg)Resort Shirakami waiting at Akita Station.![The waiting room at Higashi-Noshiro Station and the symbol of the Gono Line](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/akita/meettheheart/topics/column/img/g001/image07.jpg)The waiting room at Higashi-Noshiro Station and the symbol of the Gono Line.![Mini basketball court on Noshiro Station platform](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/akita/meettheheart/topics/column/img/g001/image08.jpg)A mini basketball court on Noshiro Station platform.![A wooden model of a beech tree on the platform at Noshiro Station](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/akita/meettheheart/topics/column/img/g001/image09.jpg)A wooden model of a beech tree placed on the platform at Noshiro Station.

This section runs along the coast of the Sea of Japan, so you can enjoy taking photos while gazing at the ocean. Passengers sitting on the mountain side can also bring their cameras or cell phones and take their favorite photos.

![Iwadate Station sign with illustration of the station](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/akita/meettheheart/topics/column/img/g001/image10.jpg)Iwadate Station sign with illustration of the station

POINT3

##### Meeting at Fukaura Station

After crossing the prefectural border and arriving at Fukaura Station in Aomori Prefecture, the train stops for six minutes.

Resort Shirakami 2 bound for Akita Station also arrives at Fukaura Station Fukaura Station the opposite platform, where two oncoming trains switch operating sections.

![Resort Shirakami 2 at Fukaura Station](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/akita/meettheheart/topics/column/img/g001/image11.jpg)Resort Shirakami No. 2 (Aoike) at Fukaura Station.

The captivating seascape and the large rocks lining the coast combine to create a spectacular natural spectacle.

![Uniquely shaped rock formations in the Sea of Japan](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/akita/meettheheart/topics/column/img/g001/image12.jpg)A uniquely shaped rock in the Sea of Japan.

POINT4

##### In-car event: Tsugaru shamisen live performance

From Ajiga Station to Aomori Station, the scenery outside the train window changes from the sea to rice fields, apple trees, and mountains.

Meanwhile, cheerful music begins to play inside the Resort Shirakami. An acoustic live performance by two Tsugaru shamisen players is broadcast to every corner of the train via the in-car announcements. Surrounded by the audience in Car 1, the Tsugaru shamisen players play classic Tsugaru folk songs such as "Tsugaru Jonkara Bushi" while Resort Shirakami is traveling. The powerful and passionate sound of the plectrum striking the strings is an experience that can only be experienced at a Tsugaru shamisen live performance.

The performance ends just after the train arrives at Goshogawara Station.

![Tsugaru shamisen player](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/akita/meettheheart/topics/column/img/g001/image13.jpg)Tsugaru shamisen player shows off his skills on a moving train.

POINT5

##### Towards Aomori Station

When you think of Aomori, the first thing that comes to mind is apples.

At Kawabe Station there is a terminal station plate with an Aomori apple on it, indicating that this is the end of the Gono Line. The train "Buna" departs from Kawabe Station and a few minutes later runs in the opposite direction to Hirosaki Station. Hirosaki is famous for its cherry blossoms and castle. Many passengers get off the train during the short break at Hirosaki Station and the train runs in the opposite direction to Aomori Station. Before arriving at the end of the line at Aomori Station, you can transfer to the Shinkansen at Shin-Aomori Station.

![Resort Shirakami Shirakami](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/akita/meettheheart/topics/column/img/g001/image14.jpg)Resort Shirakami train stopping at Kawabe Station

POINT 6

##### From Tsugaru to Akita: Afternoon to Night

Resort Shirakami No. 4 (Kurehachi formation) runs from Aomori Station along the Gono Line back to Akita Station in the afternoon, offering a completely different experience to Resort Shirakami No. 1.

Kizukuri Station is characterized by its giant "Shakoki Clay Figurine" and mysterious exterior, making it an attractive tourist spot that attracts many tourists.

![Tsugaru Railway Tsugaru-Goshogawara Station](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/akita/meettheheart/topics/column/img/g001/image15.jpg)Tsugaru Railway Tsugaru-Goshogawara Station![Kizukuri Station](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/akita/meettheheart/topics/column/img/g001/image16.jpg)Kizukuri Station

POINT7

##### Senjōjiki Station

One of the great attractions of Resort Shirakami No. 4 is that it stops at Senjōjiki Station for 15 minutes, allowing you to stop by Senjojiki Beach, a scenic spot just a short distance from Senjōjiki Station.

Three minutes before departure, the train will honk to inform passengers that it will be departing from Senjōjiki Station.

![Senjojiki Coast and the Sea of Japan](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/akita/meettheheart/topics/column/img/g001/image17.jpg)Senjojiki Coast and the Sea of Japan

POINT8

##### Amazing sunset

The Kurogane and Aoike trains met again at Fukaura Station.

When I returned to Higashi-Higashi-Noshiro Station, the starting point of the Gono Line, the tracks, platform, and seats were already glowing in the golden light of the sunset.

![Higashi-Noshiro Station and Resort Shirakami Shirakami in the sunset](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/akita/meettheheart/topics/column/img/g001/image18.jpg)Higashi-Noshiro Station and Resort Shirakami bathed in the sunset.

As the sun sank in the west, the horizon gradually turned gray and colorful flares scattered across the sky. On the train to Akita Station, the sky darkened and night fell.

![The sun slowly disappears, turning the station into gold](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/akita/meettheheart/topics/column/img/g001/image19.jpg)The sun slowly disappears, turning the station golden.

Finally, Resort Shirakami No. 4 arrived at Akita Station. We look forward to seeing you again!

![Akita Station](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/akita/meettheheart/topics/column/img/g001/image20.jpg)Akita Station. A picture-perfect end to the day.

POINT9

##### How to reserve reserved seat

Here we will introduce how to reserve seat ticket for foreign tourists. JR EAST Pass (Tohoku Area) is a rail pass that allows unlimited rides on trains from Tokyo to Akita, including Resort Shirakami and Akita Shinkansen, for five days, and was used on the trip introduced in this column.

1/ JR EAST Railway Reservation (official website)

"JR EAST Train Reservations" is the official website for online basic fare ticket reservations. It is also available in multiple languages. You can purchase various basic fare ticket issued by JR EAST here, including JR EAST PASS (Tohoku area).

This website is the only place to reserve a seat before departing from Japan. Reservations are accepted from one month before departure. For example, if you are boarding on April 1st, you can reserve reserved seat online from March 1st.

reserved seat in Ordinary Car (cars 1, 3, and 4) on Resort Shirakami can be reserved through JR-EAST Train Reservation. Once your seat reservation is confirmed, a reservation confirmation email containing your membership number and reservation details will be sent to your registered email address. Please note that your JR-EAST Train Reservations membership number is important information when obtaining tickets.

Currently, we are not accepting seat reservations for the Resort Shirakami Shirakami box seats (car 2) on this website. Also, due to system issues, the Resort Shirakami timetable for your designated departure and arrival station, such as "from Akita Station to Aomori Station," may not be available. In such cases, reservations can only be made within Japan, so please consult with a staff member at JR EAST Travel Center or a JR ticket office, or purchase directly at Reserved Seat Ticket Vending Machine.

Japan upon arrival, you can pick up your online rail passes at the JR EAST Travel Centre at major stations such as Haneda Airport, Narita Airport, Tōkyō Station and Ueno Station. You can also purchase a JR EAST Pass.

To collect your ticket reserved online at the JR EAST Travel Center, you will need to present your passport and JR-EAST Train Reservation membership number.

If you do not collect basic fare ticket by 21:00 (JST, UTC+09:00) on the day before your travel date, your reservation will be automatically canceled (free of charge).

I showed JR EAST PASS (Tohoku area) to the attendant and filled out the reserved seat application form with the train combination, departure and arrival stations, date and time. seat ticket from JR EAST 's official online reservation site "JR EAST Train Reservation" can also be picked up at JR EAST ticket offices.

3/ Reserved Seat Ticket Vending Machine

The default language of the ticket vending machine is Japanese. You can change it to English or another language by clicking the button on the top right of the touch panel.

![Reserved Seat Ticket Vending Machine](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/akita/meettheheart/topics/column/img/g001/image23.jpg)Reserved Seat Ticket Vending Machine are installed at all JR EAST.

If you wish to reserve a seat using a rail pass (such as JR EAST PASS), please follow the steps below.

First, press the "Seat reservation" or "Seat reservation with discounted basic fare ticket" button and insert one or more rail passes into the automatic ticket machine.

Next, enter the departure and arrival stations and the date and time of boarding.

Then, select a train combination from the search results. You can also choose your preferred seat from the seating map.

Once your ticket information is confirmed, you can collect your ticket or rail pass from the automatic ticket machine.
